newsitem.title: USA: Index Inc sets two-for-one reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Index Inc sets two-for-one reverse split.

text.p: Index Inc said on Monday that its shareholders had approved a two-for-one reverse stock split of its outstanding shares of common stock.

Under the terms of the reverse stock split, which will occur prior to the opening of business on Tuesday, May 13, every two shares of Index common stock will be converted into one share of new common stock, the company said in a statement.

"The reverse stock split is designed to increase the post-split per share price of the common stock to a level that may be more attractive to investors and to meet the listing criteria for the Nasdaq SmallCap Market," said David Little, president and chief executive officer of Index.
The company also said that shareholders had approved a change in the company's name from Index Inc to DXP Enterprises Inc.
